title: Knee osteoarthritis（膝骨关节炎, Knee OA）

properties.disease overview: Degenerative joint disease with cartilage loss leading to pain, stiffness, and reduced function; X-ray shows joint space narrowing, osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis, and cysts.
properties.mechanism: Progressive cartilage degeneration and subchondral bone remodeling driven by age, malalignment (varus/valgus), obesity/overuse, and prior trauma; results in mechanical pain and inflammatory flares.
properties.disorder: Knee osteoarthritis（膝骨关节炎, Knee OA）
